concept: A precise, antique proof-weaving instrument: an ivory-and-gold web gathered around a dark transaction seal. The woven object replaces the portrait and reads as crafted evidence, not a generic network.
composition: Use a square master for the 500×570 desktop portrait and 350×320 mobile landscape slots. Keep web, seal, and crescent-star detail within the central 72% safe area. Fade a few guide arcs and thread ends into charcoal edges; reserve dark negative space. At thumbnail size, the web should remain one clear luminous medallion.
strands: Show about six substantial, continuous filaments with varied spacing and thickness. Make their over-under crossings unmistakable; distinguish paths with muted ivory and antique-gold highlights. Add only a few hairline guides and sparse bead-like joins. Preserve dark gaps so strands stay crisp when reduced; avoid any countable sequence.
brandConnection: Use Moriarty’s charcoal, parchment-ivory, antique-gold palette and crescent-star seal. Gothic scientific engraving echoes the banner, while the woven form makes ‘Webs and Strands’ tangible as proof-bearing Strands collected for a transaction.
avoid: People, faces, text, numerals, neon, blue glow, globes, circuitry, random node clouds, dense hair-thin mesh, fixed proof counts, process steps, coins, chains, and automatic-execution imagery.
imagePrompt: Premium editorial hero art for Moriarty, a Cardano financial-contract language. No person. On deep charcoal, center a compact antique scientific loom-web gathered around a dark transaction seal. About six clearly separated, continuous ivory and muted antique-gold filaments weave over-under in a few elegant crossings; add restrained orbit guides, sparse bead-like evidence joins, and a tiny engraved crescent-star detail. Precise gothic instrument engraving, calm negative space, matte darkness, parchment highlights, restrained gold; legible at thumbnail scale. Square composition; keep essential geometry in the central 72% for portrait and landscape crops. No text, humans, neon, globe, generic network, dense mesh, or execution imagery.
